title: 第18章 自强不息第19章 完整版的心法

第018章 自强不息
太阳早已西沉，天也已经很黑很黑了。
黑夜，就像要把一切都给吞噬掉一样，让人的心中也跟着绝望了起来。
在这无尽的黑暗中，模模糊糊的有一颗黄豆大小的火焰正在慢慢的燃烧着，没有声响，安安静静的燃烧着。
唐安已经醒了，除了全身无力之外，他觉得自己其他的一切都没有任何变化。他多么想昨天的那一切就只是一场梦啊。可是，面对空荡荡的丹田，他却只能默默地接受这个让人无奈的事实。
房间很大，光线却很暗。
这里不是他的房间，他从醒来的那一刻就知道了。
房间里散发着一股淡淡的檀香味。这种檀香用来静心凝神拥有极好的效果，这屋子的主人，想必是个喜欢安静的人。房间布置的极为简单，有一张大床，一张圆桌，还有一排书架，墙上挂着一幅字画，笔力浑厚，铁画银钩。
画看不清楚，字却只有四个。
【自强不息】！
唐安看到这几个字忽然心中一怔，可是随即他又苦笑起来：“自强不息，这话说来容易，做起来，实在是太难了。”
就在这个时候，从门口传来了“吱嘎”的一声响，门就被从外面
那人进来后，又轻轻把门关上了，他的动作很仔细，看得出他是一个很细心的人，他并不像吵醒里面的唐安。其实，他本来是不想进来的，虽然这原本就是他的房间。
只是，他只要一看到里面床上躺着的那个孩子，他的心就充满了愧疚。
藏锋走到屋内，先是到床头看了看唐安是否醒来了。
见唐安一脸平静的躺在床上，他才又回身给桌上的油灯添了一些油。
灯亮了，房间里跟着慢慢的清晰了起来。
藏锋自顾给自己倒了一杯茶，茶水早就冷了，他也不顾，只是猛地脖子一仰，那冰凉的茶水便入了喉咙。那一阵刺骨的寒意，一下就把他刺激的头脑一阵清醒。
“藏锋啊藏锋，你今天这么做，到底是对是错呢？”房间里静悄悄的，没有任何声音，有的，也只是他自己的叹息声。
藏锋慢慢从怀里掏出了一枚金色的小令牌，这是他的师父掌教李乘风，给他的掌门令牌。他的手指轻轻在这块令牌上面抚摸着，指尖传来的触感清晰。上面清楚的写着四个字【天地正气】。

藏锋的眼睛死死的盯着这四个字，一眨也不眨！
他从来都没有觉得这四个字是如此的刺眼，如此的充满了讽刺！
忽然，他的眼睛里看到了这四个字扭曲了起来，那仿佛是在嘲笑自己，根本不配拥有这块令牌！
藏锋的心中猛地一阵激荡，他把令牌重重的往桌子上一拍。
“当然是错的！我如此作为，如何配得起这四个字！我藏锋，从今往后，将心中那浩然正气置于何地？他日我教导弟子的时候又如何义正严词？为人师表，就该以身作则，就连自己都做不到的事，又如何教导弟子非要如此！我藏锋从来都是行得正，坐的直，可如今却是……唉……”
藏锋叹了一口气，却又把金牌放回了怀里，开始闷头灌着茶水，这水冰凉刺骨，或许只有这样的刺激下，藏锋才觉得自己并没有犯迷糊。他做的一切都是为了蜀山！
他的脑海中又浮现了刚刚自己师傅，将这块令牌交给自己的时候，说是要让自己继承和维护蜀山千年来的江湖名声。
至于道义？
李乘风却没有多说。
藏锋也不是傻子，他当然明白，江湖道义在蜀山千年的名誉面前，根本就微不足道！
“咳咳~”
一阵咳嗽声，突如其来的传入了藏锋的耳中。
是从床上传来的。
唐安躺在床上，藏锋说的话，他都听到了。他原本只是想继续装睡下去，可是喉咙里忽然呛了一下，他忍不住便咳嗽了起来。
藏锋听到这声音，急忙掩饰了一下自己的表情，然后快步走到床边，搭着唐安的脉搏，检查了一下他的情况。
“你的身体无恙，只是你的内气……”
藏锋说道这里，却是说不下去了。对于一个武者来说，失去内气的打击实在是太大了。
藏锋看着唐安那黯淡的眼神，安慰自己道：“但愿，这个孩子年纪小，不明白失去内气的原因吧。如果真是这样的话，我的心里也能好受一些。若是他愿意，蜀山还有很多产业，我让他打理一些，保他做一个富家翁也没有问题。”
唐安看到藏锋为难的模样，就已经知道了自己的情况，只是他以为这只是暂时的。而唐安不知道，藏锋是因为不能公平处理王锋而内疚。
唐安以为自己明白了藏锋为何为难，却是安慰道：“我知道内气没了，可是我不怕！只要以后，我更加努力的修炼，这内气也总有一天会回来的。师兄，你不用太自责的。”

看着眼前这个六岁大的孩子那双清澈的眼眸，藏锋心中更加内疚。他多么想说，“你说的对，内气总会修炼回来的。以后师兄有空便多指导你一下，说不定你的武功就突飞猛进了。”
他总不能告诉眼前这个孩子实话，说“你的内气很有可能再也修炼不回来了。江湖上有不少人都中过碧鳞蛇毒，可是到现在为止，内气修炼回来的，却寥寥无几。”
藏锋想说些什么安慰唐安的话，可这话却是噎在了喉头，怎么也说不出来。
藏锋只能无奈的摇摇头，安慰般的摸了摸唐安的脑袋。
唐安见藏锋如此动作，再观察藏锋的表情，唐安的心中忽然一突，不禁想到：“难道我的情况竟然如此糟糕了吗？”
唐安想到这里，又看了藏锋一眼，他的眼里只有深深的愧疚。
唐安的身子顿时颤抖了起来，他的牙关咬的死死地，心中不停的自欺欺人：“这不是真的，这不是真的！”
可过了一会儿，唐安却是一把将脑海里的绝望甩了出去：“我不信，总有办法让我恢复的！就连穿越这种事都能发生，这世界上还有什么是不可能的！”
“自强不息！若是我自己都放弃了希望，那就是真的没有希望了！”
唐安的脑中忽然想到了倚天屠龙记里的张无忌，他从小寒毒攻心，没日没夜都在煎熬，而且他父母双亡，流落江湖，遭遇比自己可悲惨太多了。可是再想想他的结局怎么样。武功天下无敌，又有心爱之人长相厮守。多么完美？
想到这里，唐安便觉得暂时失去内力，也没什么大不了的。
他透过烛光，又看到了挂在墙上的那副字画。【自强不息】四个大字，深深的印在了他的脑子里。
他看着看着，忽然对藏锋说道：“师兄，你墙上的这幅字写的很好。”
藏锋一楞，转过头去，看到那墙上那四个大字，顿时一怔。
随即，藏锋便朗声大笑起来：“好孩子，好孩子，你能想通，实在是太好了。以后，只要师兄在，就绝不会让你受一点委屈的。”只是藏锋却不知道，自己这个承诺是多么的自相矛盾。
不过唐安也没有仔细听，因为就在这时，他的脑中忽然响起一个熟悉的声音。
【叮~恭喜宿主完成系统的心境磨练，正是踏上高手之路。声望+5】
【叮~宿主当前拥有声望11点，达到最低要求，开启系统藏宝阁】（外门弟子1点，内门考核赢了5场5点，再加这5点）
【叮~由于宿主目前为中毒状态，系统建议宿主购买“万灵解毒丸”，需要声望10点。】
【是否购买？】

唐安愣了一下，随即狂喜起来！
“原来如此，原来如此，我就知道不应该会是现在这个样子的。还真是绝处逢生啊！”
唐安选了确定购买之后，脑中当即就浮现了一颗黑不溜秋的药丸，而药丸底下正好写着“万灵解毒丸”五个大字，还有一行密密麻麻的小字，介绍这个药丸的功效。
万灵解毒丸：服用之后，三天之内，江湖上的所有毒素带来的负面效果全部消除，七天之内，宿主可以恢复中毒之前的状态。
有了系统的药丸，唐安只要将这个效果注入其他药丸中服用，很快就会恢复。
可是在他恢复之后，却不得不面对一个问题。
蜀山会对他怎么处理？
content_en:
Chapter 018 Continuous self-improvement
The sun had already set in the west, and the sky was already very dark.
The dark night seemed to swallow up everything, making people feel desperate.
In this endless darkness, there was a vague flame the size of a soybean burning slowly, silently, and quietly.
Tang An had woken up. Apart from his general weakness, he felt that nothing else about him had changed. How he wished that everything yesterday was just a dream. However, facing the empty Dantian, he could only silently accept this helpless fact.
The room is large but the light is very dark.
This was not his room, he knew it from the moment he woke up.
There was a faint scent of sandalwood in the room. This kind of sandalwood has an excellent effect on calming the mind. The owner of this house must be a person who likes tranquility. The room is extremely simple, with a large bed, a round table, and a row of bookshelves. There is a calligraphy and painting hanging on the wall with strong brushwork and silver hooks.
The picture cannot be seen clearly, but there are only four characters.
【Continuous self-improvement】!
Tang An was suddenly startled when he saw these words, but then he smiled bitterly: "Continuous self-improvement is easy to say, but it is really difficult to do."
At this moment, there was a "creak" sound from the door, and the door was opened from the outside.
After the man came in, he closed the door gently. His movements were very careful, and it was obvious that he was a very attentive person. He didn't seem to wake up Tang An inside. In fact, he didn't want to come in, even though this was his room.
However, as soon as he saw the child lying on the bed inside, his heart was filled with guilt.
Zang Feng walked into the house and first went to the bedside to see if Tang An was awake.
Seeing Tang An lying on the bed with a calm face, he turned around and added some oil to the oil lamp on the table.
The lights came on, and the room slowly became clearer.
Zang Feng poured himself a cup of tea. The tea was already cold, so he didn't care. He just tilted his neck and the cold tea went down his throat. That biting chill suddenly cleared his stimulated mind.
"Zang Feng, Zang Feng, what you did today was right or wrong?" The room was quiet, without any sound, except for his own sigh.
Zang Feng slowly took out a small golden token from his arms. This was the master token given to him by his master, Li Chengfeng. His fingers gently stroked the token, and the touch from his fingertips was clear. There are four words clearly written on it [Heaven and Earth are righteous].
Zang Feng's eyes were fixed on these four words without blinking!
He had never felt that these four words were so piercing and full of irony!
Suddenly, he saw these four words twisted in his eyes, as if he was laughing at himself, and he was not worthy of having this token at all!
Zang Feng's heart suddenly agitated, and he slapped the token heavily on the table.
"Of course it is wrong! How can I deserve these four words for what I have done! Where will I, Zang Feng, place the awe-inspiring righteousness in my heart from now on? How will I speak righteously and sternly when I teach my disciples in the future? As a teacher, you should set an example. Even if you can't do something yourself, how can you teach your disciples to do this! I, Zang Feng, have always behaved upright and sat upright, but now... alas..."
Zang Feng sighed, then put the gold medal back in his arms, and began to drink tea. The water was cold and biting. Perhaps only with this stimulation, Zang Feng felt that he was not confused. Everything he did was for Shushan!
His mind reappeared that when his master handed this token to him, he said that he would inherit and maintain Shushan's reputation in the world for thousands of years.
As for morality?
Li Chengfeng did notSay more.
Zang Feng is not a fool. Of course he understands that the morality of the world is insignificant in the face of Shushan's thousand-year reputation!
"Ahem~"
A coughing sound suddenly reached Zang Feng's ears.
It came from the bed.
Tang An was lying on the bed, and he heard everything Zang Feng said. He originally just wanted to continue pretending to sleep, but suddenly there was a lump in his throat, and he couldn't help but cough.
When Zang Feng heard this voice, he hurriedly concealed his expression, then quickly walked to the bed, took Tang An's pulse, and checked his condition.
"Your body is fine, it's just your inner energy..."
Zang Feng said this, but couldn't go on. For a warrior, the blow of losing inner energy is really too great.
Zang Feng looked at Tang An's gloomy eyes and comforted himself: "I hope this child is young and doesn't understand the reason for losing his inner energy. If this is the case, I will feel better. If he is willing, there are still many industries in Shushan. I will let him take care of some, and there will be no problem in ensuring that he becomes a rich man."
Tang An already knew his situation when he saw Zang Feng's troubled look, but he thought it was only temporary. But Tang An didn't know that Zang Feng felt guilty because he couldn't deal with Wang Feng fairly.
Tang An thought he understood why Zang Feng was in trouble, but he consoled him: "I know the inner energy is gone, but I'm not afraid! As long as I practice harder in the future, the inner energy will come back one day. Senior brother, you don't have to blame yourself too much."
Looking at the clear eyes of the six-year-old child in front of him, Zang Feng felt even more guilty. How much he wanted to say, "You are right, inner energy will always come back through cultivation. In the future, senior brother, I will give you more guidance when I have time, and maybe your martial arts will improve by leaps and bounds."
He couldn't tell the truth to the child in front of him, saying, "It's very likely that your inner energy will never come back after cultivating it. Many people in the world have been poisoned by green-scaled snake poison, but so far, there are only a few people who have recovered their inner energy."
Zang Feng wanted to say something to comfort Tang An, but the words were stuck in his throat and he couldn't say them out.
Zang Feng could only shake his head helplessly and touched Tang An's head comfortingly.
When Tang An saw Zang Feng acting like this, and then observing Zang Feng's expression, Tang An suddenly felt a sudden thought in his heart, and couldn't help but think: "Is my situation so bad?"
Tang An thought of this and glanced at Zang Feng again. There was only deep guilt in his eyes.
Tang An's body suddenly started to tremble. He gritted his teeth and kept deceiving himself: "This is not true, this is not true!"
But after a while, Tang An shook the despair out of his mind: "I don't believe it, there is always a way for me to recover! Even time travel can happen, what else is impossible in this world!"
"Continue to strive for self-improvement! If I give up hope myself, then there is really no hope!"
Tang An's mind suddenly thought of Zhang Wuji in "The Legend of Heaven and the Dragon Slayer". He had been suffering from cold poison since he was a child, suffering day and night. Moreover, both of his parents died and he was living in the world. His experiences were much more miserable than his own. But then think about his ending. His martial arts skills are unrivaled in the world, and his beloved one will always stay with him. How perfect?
Thinking of this, Tang An felt that temporarily losing his inner strength was no big deal.
Through the candlelight, he saw the calligraphy and painting hanging on the wall again. The four characters "Continuously strive for self-improvement" were deeply imprinted in his mind.
He looked at it and suddenly said to Zang Feng: "Senior brother, the writing on your wall is very good."
Zang Feng was stunned, turned his head, and was startled when he saw the four big characters on the wall.
Immediately, Zang Feng laughed loudly: "Good boy, good boy, it's great that you can figure it out. From now on, as long as senior brother is here, I will never let youA little aggrieved. "But Zang Feng didn't know how contradictory his promise was.
But Tang An didn't listen carefully, because at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
[Ding~ Congratulations to the host for completing the mental state training of the system and embarking on the path to becoming a master. Reputation +5】
[Ding~ The host currently has 11 reputation points, which meets the minimum requirements and opens the system treasure pavilion] (1 point for the outer disciple, 5 points for winning 5 games in the inner sect assessment, plus these 5 points)
[Ding~ Since the host is currently in a poisoned state, the system recommends that the host purchase "Wanling Jiedu Pills", which requires 10 reputation points. 】
【Do you want to buy? 】
Tang An was stunned for a moment, then became ecstatic!
“I see, that’s it, I knew it shouldn’t be like this. It’s really a desperate situation! "
After Tang An decided to buy it, a black pill immediately appeared in his mind, and underneath the pill was written the five characters "Wanling Jiedu Pill", and there was also a dense line of small characters introducing the efficacy of this pill.
Wanling Jiedu Pill: After taking it, within three days, all negative effects caused by toxins in the world will be eliminated. Within seven days, the host can return to the state before poisoning.
With the pills in the system, Tang An only needs to inject this effect into other pills and take them, and he will recover quickly.
But after he recovered, he had to face a problem.
How will Shushan deal with him?
